episodes.title: The Delaneys
episodes.summary: When the Delaney matriarch suddenly goes missing, her four children are left to piece together everything they thought they knew about their parents.

episodes.title: Logan
episodes.summary: As the search for Joy grows more intense, her son Logan steers the cops away from his own family.

episodes.title: Amy
episodes.summary: Amy gathers the community together in the hopes of bringing her mother home.

episodes.title: Brooke
episodes.summary: During a hurricane, Brooke faces her demons while the detectives pursue a new lead.

episodes.title: Troy
episodes.summary: Troy makes a risky decision while evading the police, who know he's hiding important information.

episodes.title: Stan
episodes.summary: Stan's erratic behavior fuels suspicion as a damning new piece of evidence arises.

episodes.title: Joy
episodes.summary: An arrest reveals what happened to Joy, shocking the community and shattering the Delaney family.
